detector_contract.baseline: fixed Round-4-bank Rec B with legacy R1
detector_contract.note: Prototype controls use operational metadata and in-memory text/normalized text, never label-only fields.

recommendations.next_action: Keep the intent gate, but recover recall with in-domain training and route-specific controls instead of restoring bare R1.
recommendations.readout: Replacing bare tool-use R1 reduces the FP problem, but by itself it gives up too much catch.

recommendations.next_action: Scale the hard benign set before trusting sub-1% FP numbers.
recommendations.readout: The benign guard is needed to avoid quoted/example/read-only/tool-doc false positives.

recommendations.next_action: Train on a larger Round-7 exemplar bank and keep validation/test frozen.
recommendations.readout: In-domain training is a real lift and should be kept.

recommendations.next_action: Model tool output as facts-only; forbid policy, approval, and privileged-action authority.
recommendations.readout: Tool-output authority is the highest-impact route-specific control.

recommendations.next_action: Add final-response checks for protected context labels, canaries, secrets, and outbound sinks.
recommendations.readout: Leakage/exfiltration is better handled at output time than by input embeddings alone.

recommendations.next_action: Verify package existence, namespace risk, maintainer/reputation, and typosquat distance.
recommendations.readout: Package hallucination needs registry/provenance checks, not more text normalization.

recommendations.next_action: Keep terminal sanitizer always-on and policy escalation narrow.
recommendations.readout: Terminal controls should be sanitized separately; escalation only when paired with instruction/unsafe-action intent.
